name: msc300
title: Microsoft C 3.00 (MSC.EXE and its passes P0-P3), 1985
_env_unless: the passes' own floating point emulator stops under emulation ("Floating point error: Stack overflow"); with -FPi the 8087 path runs instead
_fp_switch: the switch a function using the 8087 (or its emulator) was compiled with: the draft stage gives it to such a function's source

passes.args: -f {tag}.C -il C:\{tag6}{ze} -I C:/INCX -I C:/INCLUDE -D M_I86 -D MSDOS -D M_I86SM -W 1

_passes: the switches MSC.EXE gives each pass (small model)
_variants: release: the diskettes' passes as they are; own: the state of the compiler that compiled Microsoft C 3.00's own programs; masm400: the state that compiled MASM 4.00

noroom.note: the third pass asks whether its heap has room for one more merging of equal code (6EA9); where the original ran short (it compiled whole files) the answer was no and the merging came out the other way. A source says at which askings: /* NOROOM: 1,3 */

_libraries: by memory model: the C library, its floating point part, the 8087 emulator

carve._prologues: push bp / mov bp,sp / the frame's size in AX (xor ax,ax or mov ax,N) / call __chkstk; under -Gs no call: a frame after a return

_objects: the kit's loose objects a program may link: wildcard arguments, malloc on the stack's side, files opened binary

link._: LINK 3.01 of the diskettes, run as MSC.EXE runs it (a response file); EXEMOD after, when the project says

_inverse: the inverse model of the Lattice-lineage compilers (MS C 1.x-2.03); 3.00's codegen is the next of that line

frame_order._: the locals of a function (register ones too) get their frame slots in the order of their names' buckets in the compiler's table of names: (the sum of the name's characters) mod 11, ascending, the first next to BP (found by renaming one local of f0085b of P0: 30 names, all as predicted)

_try_switches: switches that change the code, for identify: -Gs (no stack probe: LIB 3.00)
_macros: library macros the compiler expands in line, found by the routine the expansion calls (exact/draft.py library_macros)
_data_macros: a library's data named by macros: stdio's streams, the elements of _iob (8 bytes: ptr, cnt, base, flag, file), fileno(f) its byte at +7
_table_macros: the macros of a kit header that read a library table (ctype.h's isdigit ..: (_ctype_+1)[c] & mask), read from the header itself
